-- 1) Create schema (change the name if you prefer)
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS roadsure_final;

-- 2) Enable ONE of the UUID generators (pick ONE and keep it uncommented)

-- Option A (preferred): pgcrypto => gen_random_uuid()
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

-- Option B (alternative): uuid-ossp => uuid_generate_v4()
-- CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 3) Create the session logger table
-- Note: "from" and "type" are SQL keywords. To avoid quoting everywhere,
-- I’m using safer names: sender and msg_type. (If you insist on the exact
-- names, I can provide a quoted-identifier version.)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roadsure_final.session_logger_table (
  log_id       UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),  -- or uuid_generate_v4()
  session_id   TEXT        NOT NULL,
  chat_input   TEXT        NOT NULL,
  sender       TEXT        NOT NULL,  -- was "from"
  msg_type     TEXT        NOT NULL,  -- was "type"
  occurred_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- 4) Helpful index for faster lookups by session
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_logger_session
  ON roadsure_final.session_logger_table (session_id);

INSERT INTO roadsure_final.session_logger_table
  (session_id, chat_input, sender, msg_type)
VALUES
  ('smoke-001', 'hello from smoke test', 'user', 'text')
RETURNING
  log_id, session_id, chat_input, sender AS "from", msg_type AS "type", occurred_at;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO roadsure_final.mini_cust_info
    (cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id)
  VALUES
    ('Alex Smith', 'alex@example.com', '+1 555 0100', 'smoke-001')
  RETURNING cust_id, cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id
)
SELECT * FROM ins;

-- Ensure UUID generator is available (safe to re-run)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

-- Create the full customer info table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roadsure_final.cust_info_full (
  -- UUID primary key
  record_id           UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Shared fields (same convention as mini_cust_info)
  cust_name           TEXT        NOT NULL,
  cust_email          TEXT,
  cust_phone          TEXT,
  session_id          TEXT        NOT NULL,

  -- Additional fields
  date_of_birth       DATE,
  vin                 TEXT,
  license_issue_year  INTEGER,
  desired_deductible  INTEGER,
  incidents           INTEGER,
  annual_mileage      INTEGER,

  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Helpful indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cust_info_full_session
  ON roadsure_final.cust_info_full (session_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cust_info_full_vin
  ON roadsure_final.cust_info_full (vin);

-- Smoke test: insert one full record and return it
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO roadsure_final.cust_info_full (
    cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id,
    date_of_birth, vin, license_issue_year, desired_deductible,
    incidents, annual_mileage
  )
  VALUES (
    'Alex Smith', 'alex@example.com', '+1 555 0100', 'smoke-001',
    '1994-07-12', '1HGCM82633A004352', 2016, 500,
    1, 12000
  )
  RETURNING
    record_id, cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id,
    date_of_birth, vin, license_issue_year, desired_deductible,
    incidents, annual_mileage, created_at
)
SELECT * FROM ins;

-- Upsert schema snapshots for our three existing tables into roadsure_final.total_schema_table
WITH per_table AS (
  SELECT
    c.table_schema AS schema_name,
    c.table_name   AS table_name,
    jsonb_object_agg(c.column_name, to_jsonb(c.data_type)) AS columns
  FROM information_schema.columns c
  WHERE c.table_schema = 'roadsure_final'
    AND c.table_name IN (
      'session_logger_table',
      'mini_cust_info',
      'cust_info_full'
    )
  GROUP BY c.table_schema, c.table_name
)
INSERT INTO roadsure_final.total_schema_table (schema_name, table_name, columns)
SELECT schema_name, table_name, columns
FROM per_table
ON CONFLICT (schema_name, table_name)
DO UPDATE SET
  columns     = EXCLUDED.columns,
  captured_at = now();

-- Smoke test: verify rows exist and inspect column map
SELECT
  schema_name,
  table_name,
  jsonb_pretty(columns) AS columns,
  captured_at
FROM roadsure_final.total_schema_table
WHERE schema_name = 'roadsure_final'
  AND table_name IN ('session_logger_table','mini_cust_info','cust_info_full')
ORDER BY table_name;

-- Ensure UUID generator is available (safe to re-run)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

-- Create quote_register table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roadsure_final.quote_register (
  quote_id   UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- UUID
  cust_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
  cust_email TEXT,
  cust_phone TEXT,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Helpful index for lookups by session
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quote_register_session
  ON roadsure_final.quote_register (session_id);

WITH ins_default AS (
  INSERT INTO roadsure_final.quote_register (
    cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id
  )
  VALUES ('User A', 'a@example.com', '+1 555 0101', 'smoke-quote-004')
  RETURNING quote_id, cust_name, session_id, quote_selected, created_at
),
ins_custom AS (
  INSERT INTO roadsure_final.quote_register (
    cust_name, cust_email, cust_phone, session_id, quote_selected
  )
  VALUES ('User B', 'b@example.com', '+1 555 0102', 'smoke-quote-005', 'Gold')
  RETURNING quote_id, cust_name, session_id, quote_selected, created_at
)
SELECT * FROM ins_default
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ins_custom;

-- Migrate quote_selected from boolean -> text and enforce a sensible default

-- 1) Drop current default to allow type change
ALTER TABLE roadsure_final.quote_register
  ALTER COLUMN quote_selected DROP DEFAULT;

-- 2) Change type to TEXT, preserving existing TRUE/FALSE as 'true'/'false'
ALTER TABLE roadsure_final.quote_register
  ALTER COLUMN quote_selected TYPE TEXT
  USING (
    CASE
      WHEN quote_selected IS TRUE  THEN 'true'
      WHEN quote_selected IS FALSE THEN 'false'
      ELSE COALESCE(quote_selected::text, '')
    END
  );

-- 3) Normalize empties to 'none'
UPDATE roadsure_final.quote_register
SET quote_selected = COALESCE(NULLIF(quote_selected, ''), 'none')
WHERE quote_selected IS NULL OR quote_selected = '';

-- 4) Set NOT NULL + default 'none' going forward
ALTER TABLE roadsure_final.quote_register
  ALTER COLUMN quote_selected SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN quote_selected SET DEFAULT 'none';

-- Make sure uuid generation is available (safe to run multiple times)
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

-- Per-turn interaction log: who said what, in which session, by which agent
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roadsure_final.interaction_log (
  id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id       TEXT,
  turn_index       INTEGER,              -- 0,1,2,... if you choose to track it later
  actor            TEXT,                 -- 'user', 'initial_agent', 'fallback_agent', 'quote_agent'
  agent_phase      TEXT,                 -- 'fast', 'fallback', 'quote_flow', 'human_escalation', etc.
  message          TEXT,                 -- what was actually said (user or agent answer)
  category         TEXT,                 -- Fast / Quote / Human / All (for agent turns; NULL for user)
  confidence       NUMERIC,              -- agent confidence (NULL for user)
  needs_escalation BOOLEAN,              -- true/false for agent turns (NULL for user)
  created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Helpful index for per-session analysis
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interaction_log_session
  ON roadsure_final.interaction_log (session_id);

SELECT column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'roadsure_final'
  AND table_name   = 'interaction_log'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;

INSERT INTO roadsure_final.interaction_log (
    session_id,
    turn_index,
    actor,
    agent_phase,
    message,
    category,
    confidence,
    needs_escalation
)
VALUES (
    'test-session-001',
    1,
    'user',
    'Initial-Agent',
    'This is a test log row from n8n.',
    'Fast',
    0.95,
    false
)
RETURNING id, session_id, turn_index, actor, agent_phase, message, category,
          confidence, needs_escalation, created_at;

SELECT * 
FROM roadsure_final.interaction_log
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
